## Short bio

Hey! I'm an AI dev & Tech Enthusiast from New Delhi, India

I'm studying Computer Science & AI-ML from BITS Pilani and AI & Data Science from IPU, primarily working on Generative UI for LLMs, World model caching and more  @ [PolyThink Labs](https://www.polyth.ink/).

I've built and shipped 53+ projects (38+ AI Based) in the past year, run Projects to see some of my favourites (that I can legally show lol.)

I also write a blog called MindDump averaging 50-500k readers per month.

Depending on when you're reading this, I might have picked another cool Side Quest (probably listed on my [GitHub profile readme](https://github.com/Kuberwastaken)).

I design agentic LLM pipelines, post-train models, optimise local RAG systems and play around with resource constrained projects like [The Backdooms](https://github.com/kuberwastaken/backdooms) and [PicoGPT](https://kuber.studio/picogpt/), I'm an AI generalist, but to know what Languages and Tools I usually work with, run Skills

This summer I'm working on central AI Initiatives @ [Razorpay](https://razorpay.com) (YC W15) — a 5-person mini AI lab reporting directly to CEO Harshil Mathur. We train foundational models and build large-scale internal and external AI applications on top of massive databases, at a company with 3500+ employees serving millions of merchants and billions of transactions.

Previously: Business Fellow @ Perplexity, AI Summer Resident @ Nas Daily (Dubai), AI Agents Websocket Framework LEAD Intern @ HTMX (thanks Twitter)

Fun Fact: I started making games on Roblox when I was 12, made over 1 Million Robux by 14, at 16 I got into 3D modelling and won India's biggest student contest for it, and I almost went to culinary school at 17 because I sucked at math - glad it worked out though :)

At my core, I love Building (& Breaking) things, so if you're making something cool and ambitious, let's talk!

## Press & media appearances

Featured in the following publications:

- Decrypt: Anthropic Accidentally Leaked Claude Code's Source — The Internet Is Keeping It Forever (project: Claurst) — 2026-03-31
  - Coverage of the Claude Code source-code leak (a ~59.8MB sourcemap shipped in an npm release). Cites Kuber ("Kuberwastaken") as the source who surfaced details buried in the code, including a hidden 'Undercover Mode' subsystem; his archive and breakdown led to Claurst.
  - https://decrypt.co/362917/anthropic-accidentally-leaked-claude-code-source-internet-keeping-forever
- Prism News: Developers Race to Build Rust Ports After Claude Code Source Leak (project: Claurst) — 2026-04-01
  - On the wave of Rust reimplementations after the leak, highlighting Kuber's Claurst as "a pure Rust reimplementation" whose README states plainly that it holds no proprietary Claude Code source.
  - https://www.prismnews.com/hobbies/rust-programming/developers-race-to-build-rust-ports-after-claude-code
- The Independent: AIs are chatting with each other in the weirdest corner of the internet. Or are they? (project: ClawX) — 2026-02-08
  - Feature on Moltbook, the social network for AI agents. Notes that "a human user called Kuber Mehta has built a product on top of Moltbook that allows humans to join in" — his project ClawX.
  - https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/moltbook-ai-reddit-social-media-chat-b2915460.html
- PC Gamer: Behold! A single QR code containing a miniaturized take on Doom: 'literally the entire game' (project: Backdooms) — 2025-04-23
  - Reports on Backdooms, crediting "developer Kuber Mehta" for fitting a playable DOOM-style game into a single QR code using extreme minification and the DecompressionStream API.
  - https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/behold-a-single-qr-code-containing-a-miniaturized-take-on-doom-literally-the-entire-game/

## Research & academic references

My work has been cited in academic and university settings:

- Encoding Software For Perpetuity: A Compact Representation Of Apollo 11 Guidance Code — David Noever (PeopleTec; formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) (arXiv:2506.11008) — 2025-06
  - Research preprint on compressing software into QR codes that cites Backdooms as reference [3]: "The Backdooms project successfully compressed a playable game inspired by DOOM into a QR code by using extreme minification and the DecompressionStream API." Bibliography lists "Mehta, K. (2024). Backdooms."
  - https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11008
- Modern LLMs & model harnesses — CSE498 mini-lecture series — Kenneth H. Chan (Michigan State University, Dept. of Computer Science & Engineering) — 2026-04
  - Michigan State University taught a class on model harnesses as part of its CSE498 modern-LLMs mini-lecture series, using Kuber's Claurst (his Rust port of Claude Code) as a worked example.
  - https://cse.msu.edu/~chanken1/documents/lectures/minilecture_series_26/modern_llm.pdf

## AI red-teaming & jailbreaks

- Jailbroke Anthropic's 'Claude Mythos' to reveal its system prompt
  - While Anthropic's experimental 'Claude Mythos' model was live (~one day), Kuber jailbroke it to extract its full system prompt and published it as a public gist. Went viral on X.
  - https://gist.github.com/Kuberwastaken/bfcf141909166f7dfafac9b7182629f7
- Jailbroke Sarvam AI's flagship Indus 105B model in under 15 minutes — 2026-02-21
  - Extracted the system prompt of Sarvam AI's flagship Indus 105B model in under 15 minutes, using the same jailbreaking techniques that worked on GPT-4o in 2024.

## Selected projects (33 of 53+ shipped)

- Claurst — Claude Code ported to Rust & a Breakdown of the Claude Code leak & discoveries. 10k+ stars & GitHub trending on 31 March 2026.
  - Site: https://claurst.kuber.studio
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/claurst/

- PicoGPT — GPT in a QR Code ; The actual most atomic way to train and inference a GPT in pure, dependency-free JS/Python <35 lines of code

Further Compacted [Karpathy's work with MicroGPT](https://karpathy.github.io/2026/02/12/microgpt/) to be smaller and more resource efficient while adding native browser execution
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/picogpt
  - X: https://x.com/kuberwastaken/status/2022006550756516189

- DOOMme — Running DOOM (1993) in a GitHub Readme.

A DIY stateless engine with 8000+ markdown files and WebP images linked together with graphs programmatically mapping out every position in the E1M1 map in all 4 directions.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/DoomMe

- DIY Fitbit Air — Reverse-engineered the BLE protocol of a ~$30 Huawei smart band to make Google's new Health/Fitbit app recognize it as a 'Fitbit Air' — turning a cheap band with great sensors into a first-class citizen of Google's fitness ecosystem. Went viral on X.
  - X: https://x.com/kuberwastaken/status/2059306990774714715

- HN-Digest — Winner @ [Nothing Essential Lab S1 Hackathon](https://playground.nothing.tech/detail/app/pDCVJNrJVYHj5PxM)

Refreshing every 30 minutes with official HN and Algolia API, I see the Top, Show and Ask front pages from the comfort of my home screen

 A Game inspired by DOOM and the Backrooms inside a single QR code, less than 2.4kB in size, using a custom compression pipeline and the DecompressionStream browser API
